Name: Shortcut Reference Hub - Mod Keybind Manager and Reference
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
This mod was inspired from a conversation with a private user.

[center][size=6][b]Mod Shortcut Reference Hub[/b][/size]
[size=4]Never forget your mod keybindings again![/size][/center]
[quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[size=3][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url][/quote]

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Are you tired of forgetting which key opens which mod menu? Do you have dozens of mods installed and can't remember all the shortcuts? [b]Mod Shortcut Reference Hub[/b] is your solution!

This mod provides a clean, organized interface where you can document and reference all your mod keybindings in one convenient location. Press [b]K[/b] to open the hub and instantly see all your shortcuts!

[quote]You Will love this: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40282?tab=description]GMCM Quick Search - Generic Mod Config Menu Search[/url][/quote]

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41846/41846-1769878348-847407839.gif[/img]﻿[/center]

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Centralized Reference System[/b] - All your shortcuts in one place
[*][b]Pre-populated Keys[/b] - Comes with A-Z and F1-F12 keys ready to customize
[*][b]Custom Shortcuts[/b] - Add your own custom key combinations (including Ctrl, Shift, Alt modifiers)
[*][b]Search Function[/b] - Quickly filter shortcuts by key or description
[*][b]Smart Sorting[/b] - Sort by key, description, or show custom shortcuts first
[*][b]Hide Empty Slots[/b] - Toggle to show only shortcuts you've customized
[*][b]Easy Editing[/b] - Click any shortcut to add or edit its description
[*][b]Color-Coded[/b] - Custom shortcuts appear in different colors for easy identification
[/list][center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41846/41846-1769878292-1681556432.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Press [b]K[/b] to open the Shortcut Reference Hub
[*]Click [b](Edit)[/b] next to any shortcut to add a description
[*]Click [b]Add New[/b] to create custom shortcuts with modifier keys
[*]Use the [b]Search[/b] bar to quickly find specific shortcuts
[*]Click [b]Sort[/b] to change how shortcuts are organized
[*]Click [b]Hide Empty[/b] to show only shortcuts with descriptions
[/list]

[size=4][b]Example Use Cases[/b][/size]
[code]E - "Open inventory (CJB Cheats Menu)"
Q - "Quest menu"
F1 - "Lookup Anything mod"
J - "Automate mod overlay"
Ctrl + K - "Custom warp menu"[/code]
[center]﻿[youtube]MnqjAiK9NVc[/youtube][/center]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[*]Press [b]K[/b] in-game to open the hub!
[/list]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The mod saves your shortcuts automatically in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]. You can:
[list]
[*]Edit shortcuts in-game (recommended)
[*]Manually edit the config file if needed
[*]Your preferences are saved between game sessions
[/list]

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Q: Does this mod detect shortcuts from other mods automatically?[/b]
A: No, this is a manual reference system. You need to add descriptions yourself, but that's what makes it flexible for any mod combination!

[b]Q: How many shortcuts can I add?[/b]
A: Unlimited! The list scrolls and has a search function.

[b]Q: Can I use modifier keys like Ctrl, Shift, Alt?[/b]
A: Yes! Click "Add New" and press your key combination - it will capture modifiers automatically.

[b]Q: Will my shortcuts be lost if I update the mod?[/b]
A: No! Your shortcuts are saved in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] and persist through updates.

[b]Q: Can I have really long descriptions?[/b]
A: Yes! There's no character limit. Long descriptions will be truncated with "..." in the list view but the full text is saved.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] Requires SMAPI 3.0 or higher
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] Compatible with 1.6+
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Works in multiplayer (each player has their own shortcuts)
[*][b]Other Mods:[/b] No known conflicts - this is a reference tool only!
[/list]
